notes: Breadboard coordinates are estimated from the image: the image's upper half (rows f-j) is catalogue bank 'b' and the lower half (rows a-e) is bank 't'.
The bottom power rail: the upper line (black marker) is treated as ground 'bn' and the lower line (red +) as 5V 'bp'. Hole numbers on the rails are approximate; each rail is a single strip.
The pushbutton straddles the centre gap in columns 4 and 6. Column 4 side (side 1) goes to 5V. Column 6 side (side 2) goes to pin 2 and to the 10k pull-down resistor, which runs to the GND rail.
The black wire from the Uno goes to the second GND pin (GND.2) on the power header.
The 10k resistor is written as value=10000 (ohms).
